integrity.computation: Direct ordered-triple enumeration through length 19 and collision-by-collision comparison.
integrity.proof: Complete elementary derivation for every integer length; finite tests are additional checks only.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to binary words of Hamming weight three and scattered triples. Finite replay through length 19 is not an infinite proof. Unindexed earlier literature may still contain an equivalent proof.
title: Exact classification of binary weight-three scattered triple decks
